overall_summary: Data clearly shows that relationship dynamics, particularly husband-wife and romantic connection realities (e.g., 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?', 'पत्नी की ये बात...'), dramatically outperform generic poetry or family member shout-outs. We must lean heavily into adult relationship topics while maintaining our emotional core.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on post-marriage love and wives' perspectives received 1,770 and 1,679 views respectively, outperforming almost everything else by an order of magnitude.
winning_patterns.action: Produce more short-form content addressing unsaid emotional conflicts in modern marriages and partnerships.

winning_patterns.evidence: 'Har Baar Sorry Bolne Wala Galat Nahi Hota' achieved 392 views, doing significantly better than standard abstract sad shayari.
winning_patterns.action: Use specific emotional burdens or relationship micro-behaviors as hooks rather than broad statements.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' generated only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid heavy, melodramatic, or overly poetic vocabulary. Keep the Hindi conversational and grounded.

weak_patterns.evidence: Earlier sister/sibling posts like 'बहन सिर्फ घर की रौनक होती है' stalled out around 19 to 139 views.
weak_patterns.action: Pivot away from generic family tributes unless tied to a hard, relatable psychological real-life conflict.
